changeSet.author: desafio-matriculas
changeSet.comment: Prefixa codigo da turma com codigo da disciplina (ex.: T1 -> CC-ALG-T1)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE t SET t.codigo = d.codigo + N'-' + t.codigo, t.atualizado_em = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM turma t INNER JOIN disciplina d ON d.id = t.disciplina_id WHERE t.codigo IN (N'T1', N'T2');
